data.title: Moonlight Silver Forum 2026 Introduces “The Next Benchmark”
data.description: Moonlight Bullion Refinery Co., Ltd. highlights a pivotal shift in the silver jewelry industry, as competition across the Global Jewelry Supply Chain moves beyond quality, pricing, and manufacturing capabilities toward “The Next Benchmark” — a new competitive landscape increasingly shaped by Responsible Sourcing, Traceability, Transparency, Certification, and Sustainability. In response to this transformation, the company is hosting “Moonlight Silver Forum 2026,” bringing together industry leaders and businesses to exchange perspectives, anticipate emerging standards, and strengthen their readiness to compete in an evolving global market.

data.title: Bangkok’s sacred Lakshmi Shrine and Varalakshmi Vratam
data.description: Nestled high above the bustling luxury of the Ratchaprasong intersection, Bangkok’s spiritual heart is home to a unique cluster of sacred shrines dedicated to nine revered deities.

data.title: ZTE and AIS Launch ZTE Day Thailand 2026 to Drive Intelligent Networks
data.description: ZTE and AIS launched ZTE Day Thailand 2026,showcasingintelligent network solutions to accelerate Thailand's smarter, more sustainable digital transformation

data.title: Pi Securities hosts AI-era investment seminar
data.description: Pi Private Wealth ,a part of Pi Securities Public Co Ltd (“Pi Securities”) , hosted the “Navigating Your Portfolio in the AI Era: 2H 2026”seminarunder the theme “How to Build an Investment Portfolio in the AI Era”. The event provided insights into the economic outlook and key investment strategiesfor the second half of 2026, with a particular focus on the opportunities and challenges arising from artificial intelligence, the digitaleconomy and related industries. The seminar also explored practical approaches to portfolio construction, asset allocationand risk diversification, equipping investors with strategies to navigate rapidly evolving market conditions and capture opportunities in the AI-driven investment landscape.

data.title: Norway's new Queen Mette-Marit, a fairytale beset by woe
data.description: OSLO - The life of Norway's new Queen Mette-Marit was once considered a fairytale, but a lung transplant, her son's rape conviction and her friendship with convicted US sex offender Jeffrey Epstein have made it anything but that in recent years.

data.title: Norway's King Harald dead at 89
data.description: OSLO - Norway's King Harald has died at the age of 89, the palace said on Friday, his 53-year-old son Crown Prince Haakon automatically succeeding him on the throne.

data.title: Haakon, the reluctant prince who became Norway's new king
data.description: OSLO — Haakon, who comes to the throne as two major scandals batter his family, struggled ​for years to accept his status.

data.title: Bar manager accused of shaving woman's head over unpaid bill
data.description: A bar manager is facing backlash after a viral clip showed him shaving a female customer's head with clippers over an unpaid bill, a case that has drawn calls for a police investigation and concern for the young woman's welfare.

data.title: Peter Cullen, the voice behind Optimus Prime and Eeyore, dies
data.description: Peter Cullen, the Canadian voice actor whose unmistakable baritone brought Optimus Prime in the Transformers franchise and Eeyore in Winnie the Pooh to life, has died at the age of 85.

data.title: Double A reports Q2 2026 revenue of 5.33 billion baht and net profit of 267 million baht
data.description: Double A (1991) Public CompanyLimited (Double A)has announced its operating results for the second quarter of 2026, reporting total revenue of 5.334 billionbaht, an increase of 1.83% compared with the same period last year, and a net profit of 267 millionbaht. The results were driven by the company’s effective cost management and continuous adjustments to its production and logistics plans, which helped mitigate the impact of external pressures and ensure that products were delivered to customers as planned, amid the ongoing tensions in the Middle East.

data.title: Chilean men arrested over theft of watches worth B41m in Tokyo
data.description: Two Chilean men were arrested on Thursday for allegedly stealing luxury watches from a shop in Tokyo, an investigative source said.

data.title: US court rules Pentagon ban of Anthropic unlawful
data.description: SAN FRANCISCO (UNITED STATES) - A US federal judge ruled on Thursday that sanctions imposed by the Trump administration against AI giant Anthropic were illegal, finding that the government punished the company in a row over military use of its technology.

data.title: Anger in Austria over business park on former Nazi camp site
data.description: LEOBERSDORF (AUSTRIA) - A few crumbling concrete blocks in an overgrown field are all that remains visible of what was once a sprawling Nazi forced labour complex around the Austrian town of Leobersdorf.

data.title: Your weekly horoscope for Aug 28 - Sept 3
data.description: Your spot-on weekly horoscope for work, money and relationship from Guru by the Bangkok Post 's famously accurate fortune teller. Let's see how you will fare this week and beyond.

data.title: JAI by ONESIAM presents “JAI Rising”
data.description: JAI by ONESIAM officially unveiled “JAI Rising: A Journey Like No Other,” marking a new chapter for a global invitation-only private members’ club. The launch brings together business founders, entrepreneurs, creators and next-generation leaders from diverse fields through a community that inspires new perspectives and meaningful connections.

data.title: Tanker pays record US$5.3 mn to transit Panama Canal: administrator
data.description: PANAMA CITY - A tanker carrying liquefied petroleum gas has paid US$5.3 million (175 million baht) for priority passage through the Panama Canal ahead of El Nino-related restrictions, the waterway's deputy administrator, Ilya Espino de Marotta, told AFP on Thursday.

data.title: Thailand's southern insurgency leaves villagers trapped in a cycle of fear
data.description: NARATHIWAT — Security guard Ni-arfan Doloh was taking a routine photograph for his nightly report on Saturday ‌when five masked men carrying rifles emerged from inside a government office in this southern border province of Thailand.

data.title: Tourism Ministry to deport misbehaving foreign tourists as new regulation takes effect
data.description: Tourism and Sports Minister Surasak Phancharoenworakul has backed Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul’s latest directive, pledging to enforce newly-enacted legal measures aimed at cracking down on and deporting foreign tourists who engage in inappropriate behaviour, cause public disturbances, show disrespect for Thai culture or create hardship for Thai citizens and other visitors.

data.title: 'Find your own room': Japan says can't handle added Asian Games numbers
data.description: TOKYO - Japanese organisers have told late additions to next month's Asian Games to find their own accommodation, saying they don't have the money or space to deal with ballooning participant numbers.

data.title: Deportation regulation takes effect, targets lawbreaking foreigners
data.description: A new regulation setting out clear procedures for deporting foreign nationals from Thailand has come into effect, following its publication in the Royal Gazette .

data.title: Guns, drugs and car chases: GTA 6 preview lands on Netflix after leaks
data.description: SAN FRANCISCO (UNITED STATES) - Rockstar Games on Thursday launched, for the first time on Netflix, a preview of its hotly anticipated next installment in the Grand Theft Auto franchise, which will be released in November after a months-long delay and recent leaks.

data.title: Eight students arrested after morning brawl at Siam
data.description: Eight students were arrested after a fight between groups from two rival educational institutions broke out on the OneSiam Skywalk in Pathumwan district on Friday morning, leaving four people injured.

data.title: Arsenal face depleted Aston Villa, Spurs seek return on $408m spend
data.description: MANCHESTER — Arsenal are out to inflict more damage on a wounded Aston Villa, while Tottenham are desperate to see some return for their £300 million ($408 million) investment in new signings when Newcastle visit north London.

data.title: Fresh flood warnings for disaster-hit Nepal and Tibet, 1,400 still missing
data.description: BIDUR (NEPAL) - China and Nepal warned of fresh flooding risks, complicating rescuers' search Friday for more than 1,400 people missing after a deadly deluge and landslides swept away entire villages along their remote Himalayan border.
